name: lightweight-feedback-system
description: Manager-to-employee feedback app: FastAPI + async MongoDB, JWT auth, role and per-record access checks, pytest + CI

paragraphs: Managers give structured feedback to their team (strengths, areas to improve, sentiment). Employees see their own feedback history and acknowledge each item.
Stack: React (CRA) · FastAPI · MongoDB (Motor, async) · JWT auth · bcrypt · Docker · GitHub Actions
features: Register and log in as manager or employee (JWT, bcrypt-hashed passwords)
Managers: see the team, submit feedback, edit their own feedback
Employees: read their own history (newest first) and acknowledge items
Role checks on every endpoint, plus per-record checks (employees can only read and acknowledge their own feedback)
Input validation with Pydantic: roles and sentiment are enums, with length limits on text fields

whatItDoes.text: Managers give structured feedback to their team (strengths, areas to improve, sentiment). Employees see their own feedback history and acknowledge each item.

requirements.text: Register and log in as manager or employee (JWT, bcrypt-hashed passwords)
They cover registration and login status codes, validation, token checks, role permissions, and per-record access (an employee can't read or acknowledge someone else's feedback).
